what_this_was: A data file of the Overlay Friction Index (OFI) family: a 0-100 lender overlay score, its forecasts, components or the data behind its pages.
why: The index's historical values, which its forecasting model was trained on, are typed into the model's code with no source; its methodology said it was recalculated from HMDA releases, which are annual and cannot give quarterly values. A figure that cannot be traced to a source is not published on this site.
